mapping_reason: Total bovine herd. It constrains the sum of the two WHEP cattle groups, and cattle_non_dairy is this class minus the published dairy series, the unit-year being refused where that difference is negative (T10 livestock rule 1).
A published dairy series binds dairy cattle (T10 livestock rule 1).
NASS publishes the annual hog inventory as of 1 December; the published reference date is accepted as it is (T10 livestock rule 3).
WHEP carries one sheep_goats group, so sheep and goats are summed into it (T10 livestock rule 2). NASS's sheep series constrains the group alone, the goat share not being covered by it.
